zh.name: 交接清单
zh.summary: 把会话整理成接手人可以照着做的交接说明。
zh.use: 在接收 Latch 技能的「我的 Agent」中选用「交接清单」，再发送「帮我整理一份交接」。
zh.agent: 提供核对证据、列出未决问题和下一步的写作步骤。适用于内置 Agent 和接收 Latch 技能的 Harness。
zh.access: 只包含文本技能，正文会交给选用它的 Agent。

en.name: Shift handoff
en.summary: Turn the conversation into handoff notes someone can act on.
en.use: Select the handoff skill for an agent that accepts Latch skills. Ask it to prepare a handoff.
en.agent: Gives the agent a method for reporting evidence, open questions and next steps. Supports the built-in agent and Harnesses that accept Latch skills.
en.access: Contains text instructions that the selected agent can read.

zh.name: 发布清单面板
zh.kind: 会话面板 · 工具 · 技能
zh.summary: 在对话旁勾选发布条件，把清单交给 Agent 核对。
zh.use: 在内置 Agent 会话右栏点「＋」，打开「发布清单」。勾选后点「写入对话」，检查草稿再发送。
zh.agent: 提供检查技能及汇总清单的工具。工具只汇总输入，实际测试证据仍需核对。
zh.access: 包含用 Host 权限运行的模块和与工作台页面同权的面板。首次应用这份代码需在 Mac 确认。

en.name: Release checklist panel
en.summary: Mark release criteria beside the conversation and hand them to the agent.
en.use: In a built-in agent session, choose + in the sidebar and open the release checklist. Add your selections to the draft and send it.
en.agent: Adds a release review skill and a tool for summarizing the supplied checks. Test evidence still needs verification.
en.access: Runs code with Host and workbench page permissions. Confirm this code on the host Mac before applying it.

zh.name: 发布检查记录
zh.summary: 按项目发起检查，回看每一项的状态、证据和备注。
zh.use: 先用样例数据预览页面。应用后，从「应用」打开「发布检查」，选择项目并开始一次检查。原生 iOS 当前需用手机浏览器打开。
zh.agent: 页面会新开检查会话，读取它发起的回复并存档。使用所选项目的默认权限。
zh.access: 隔离页面可读取允许的会话摘要、发起会话、读取自己发起的回复，并使用插件与项目存储。首次授予页面能力需在 Mac 确认。

en.name: Release check history
en.summary: Run a release check for a project and review evidence and notes later.
en.use: Preview with sample data, then apply. Open the release check from Apps and choose a project. On iOS, open the full page in a mobile browser.
en.agent: Starts a check in a new session with project defaults and keeps the reply from that session.
en.access: An isolated page can list permitted session summaries, start sessions, read its own replies and use plugin and project storage. Grant new page capabilities on the host Mac.

zh.name: 上下文
zh.summary: 比较请求组成和逐轮窗口用量，点选工具结果可跳回原文。
zh.use: 在会话右栏点「＋」，打开「上下文」。选择一次内置 Agent 请求可查看工具输出，选择窗口报告可回到对应轮次。Claude 上报分类或压缩时可查看明细。
zh.agent: 供你查看会话统计，Agent 无需执行额外步骤。
zh.access: 面板与工作台页面同权。上下文接口提供当前会话的只读统计和回合跳转。首次应用这份代码需在 Mac 确认。

en.name: Context
en.summary: Compare request inputs and window usage by turn. Jump to the tool output behind a change.
en.use: Choose + in the session sidebar and open Context. Select a built-in agent request to inspect its tool outputs, or a window report to revisit its turn. Claude window categories and compaction details appear when reported.
en.agent: Shows you session statistics without requiring extra work from the agent.
en.access: The panel runs with workbench page permissions. The context interface provides read-only statistics and turn navigation for the current session. Confirm this code on the host Mac before applying it.
